t.7647-01-0.agn: The classification shown is for the solution (index no 017-002-01-X); gaseous hydrogen chloride is classified separately. The Turkish Ministry of Health advises against mixing it with bleach; mixing releases chlorine gas.
t.7647-01-0.pw.0: Its vapour irritates the airways (H335); do not use in a closed space.
t.7647-01-0.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 017-002-01-X (CLP00): STOT SE 3, Skin Corr. 1B.
t.7647-01-0.summary: Hydrogen chloride dissolved in water; also called spirits of salt or muriatic acid.
t.7647-01-0.what: Dissolves limescale, rust and mineral deposits.
